items.name: Sanity Black
items.role: The primary canvas and dominant surface color. Not pure black but close enough to feel absolute. The foundation of the entire visual identity.

items.name: Pure Black
items.role: Used for maximum-contrast moments, deep overlays, and certain border accents.

items.name: Sanity Red
items.role: The primary CTA and brand accent -- a warm coral-red that serves as the main call-to-action color. Used for "Get Started" buttons and primary conversion points.

items.name: Electric Blue
items.role: The universal hover/active state color across the entire system. Buttons, links, and interactive elements all shift to this blue on hover. Also used as --color…

items.name: Light Blue
items.role: Secondary blue variants used for accent backgrounds, badges, and dimmed blue surfaces.

items.name: Neon Green
items.role: ): A vivid, wide-gamut green used as --color-fg-accent-green for success states and premium feature highlights. Falls back to #19d600 in sRGB.

items.name: Near Black
items.role: Default page background and primary surface.

items.name: Dark Gray
items.role: Elevated surface color for cards, secondary containers, input backgrounds, and subtle layering above the base canvas.

items.name: Medium Dark
items.role: Tertiary surface and border color for creating depth between dark layers.

items.name: Pure White
items.role: Used for inverted sections, light-on-dark text, and specific button surfaces.

items.name: Light Gray
items.role: Light surface for inverted/light sections and subtle background tints.

items.name: White
items.role: Primary text color on dark surfaces, maximum legibility.

items.name: Silver
items.role: Secondary text, body copy on dark surfaces, muted descriptions, and placeholder text.

items.name: Medium Gray
items.role: Tertiary text, metadata, timestamps, and de-emphasized content.

items.name: Charcoal
items.role: Text on light/inverted surfaces.

items.name: Near Black Text
items.role: Primary text on white/light button surfaces.

items.name: Error Red
items.role: Destructive actions, validation errors, and critical warnings -- a pure, high-saturation red.

items.name: GPC Green
items.role: Privacy/compliance indicator green.

items.name: Focus Ring Blue
items.role: Focus ring color for accessibility, matching the interactive blue.

items.name: Dark Border
items.role: Primary border on dark containers -- barely visible, maintaining minimal containment.

items.name: Subtle Border
items.role: Standard border for inputs, textareas, and card edges on dark surfaces.

items.name: Medium Border
items.role: More visible borders for emphasized containment and dividers.

items.name: Light Border
items.role: Border on inverted/light elements or buttons needing contrast separation.

strengths.title: 마우스를 올리면 모두 파랑이 된다
strengths.why: 주요 버튼은 코랄 #f36458 알약이다. 모든 버튼과 링크는 마우스를 올리면 파랑 #0052ef로 바뀐다.

strengths.title: 큰 제목일수록 자간을 크게 좁힌다
strengths.why: waldenburgNormal 112px 제목은 굵기 400, 자간 -4.48px, 72px는 -2.88px이다. 600 굵기는 11px 대문자 라벨에만 쓴다.

strengths.title: 모서리는 12px 다음 바로 알약이다
strengths.why: 입력창 3px, 보조 버튼 5px, 카드 6px, 큰 카드 12px이고 그다음은 99999px 알약이다. 그 사이 값은 쓰지 않는다.

strengths.title: 그림자 대신 면 밝기로 층을 올린다
strengths.why: #0b0b0b 바탕에서 #212121, #353535, #ffffff 순으로 밝아지며 층이 올라간다. 그림자는 0 0 0 1px 같은 테두리형만 쓴다.

learn: 어두운 화면을 만들 때 Sanity처럼 회색에 색조를 빼고 완전한 무채색 단계로 두면 강조색이 더 또렷해진다.
눌러지는 상태를 통일하고 싶다면 Sanity처럼 모든 버튼·링크의 마우스 올림 색을 한 색(#0052ef)으로 맞춘다.
